title: Spaceapps Trilingual Marketing Site
role: Design Engineer — design remediation, implementation, and integrations
attribution: Spaceapps owned the project and its client relationship. Thiago designed the homepage; Juan Silva remediated that handoff, implemented the site, authored the legal, 404, and localized routes, and built the lead-capture service.
impact: Implemented 11 homepage sections, three legal pages, a custom 404, three locale routes, and a lead-capture service with isolated writes to two Google Sheets plus Mailgun notifications.
